changes.title: Bag accuracy
items: The Bumbag, Tote, Duffel and Backpack throw less straight, and the Backpack and Bumbag spread wider the longer you keep throwing

changes.title: Found bags
items: Four new bags to find in the forest, each its own way to throw 💌s: the Tote (a spray of five, short reach), the Duffel (bursts of four, a long reload), the Briefcase (slow letters that seek) and the Backpack (a stream of letters that slows you down)

changes.title: Bag names
items: The bags go by their own names: Satchel, Bumbag and Purse

changes.title: Pixel snap
items: The pixel art is crisper on screens scaled to 125% or 150%: every pixel is now the same size, not some a quarter narrower than the next
Half as much blur at the top and bottom of the screen
